capabilities: Show a floating toolbar on selected text in editing and reading views
Generate AI overviews, explanations, translations, and expansions using note context
Save generated concept cards as notes in a configurable folder
Detect duplicate concepts and open existing notes instead of creating copies
Configure AI providers, output language, and right-to-left display
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns that AI actions send selected text and note context to the configured provider and advises reviewing provider privacy policies; supports OpenAI-compatible presets including OpenAI, Kimi, Qwen, GLM, Doubao, DeepSeek, SiliconFlow, OpenRouter, Anthropic, and Gemini.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up or generate explanations for unfamiliar terms selected while reading and store them as reusable concept notes.

requires.name: AI provider account (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Gemini, etc.)

summary: AI-assisted term capture that shows a floating toolbar on selected text to explain, translate, expand, and save concepts as reusable notes.
